title: Connector Typed Operation
description: Request and response shapes for POST /v1/connectors/{connector_id}/operations. A Connector-backed Tool has exactly one seam: the typed operation. The Tool never reaches the customer's data source itself (docs/runtime-adapter.md D6), so the operation name, its input and its result are the whole contract between the Solution and the Connector — and every call is authorized, tenant-scoped and recorded by context-service rather than by the runtime app.

connector_id.description: The Connector's name from the Customer-level manifest; it must equal the path parameter.

operation.description: The typed operation, as the Connector manifest declares it (camelCase in v0: `lookupClaim`).

input.description: The operation's arguments, validated against the input schema the Tool pinned.

result.description: The operation's output, shaped by the output schema the Tool pinned.
